judgements.justification: B's chair cited unresolved motivation for the DSCS kernel and last-layer-Laplace-only experiments, not an overstated headline claim or title; no reviewer asked for a claim to be narrowed.
No committee settled on flat marginal-accept scores: A gave four 7s (one confident-1 but not marginal), and B's 6s came from engaged reviewers alongside a 7 and a well-grounded 8.
